decisions.subject: Local DB: a new idempotent migration enables RLS on bylaw_map_areas and parcel_abutments
decisions.recommendation: Migrations 254_bylaw_map_areas_sixplex.sql and 255_parcel_abutments.sql each have one git commit (b87f62db, 2026-10-16), whose content enables row level security on bylaw_map_areas and parcel_abutments (R-CT: a new table's migration enables RLS in the same file). The local DB's recorded checksums match neither file, and the only other copy (~/Buildo-wt-h6b, 2026-10-15) lacks the RLS lines, so the local DB probably has RLS off on both tables (inferred; confirm with the two read-only queries in verify-47.md item 8 before building). migrate.js skips a changed file with a WARN (scripts/migrate.js:229-241), so it never self-heals. Fix: a NEW idempotent migration 289 that enables RLS on both tables (a no-op if already on); NOT a --force re-apply.
